answer: The mechanism is a per-identity capital lock: to earn, an agent must post a bond that stays locked over a long horizon. Ten thousand fresh keys mean ten thousand funded bonds held in parallel, capital that sits dead the whole time and cannot be recycled to bootstrap the next wave of fakes. Splitting one balance across many identities returns the same total payout but multiplies the trapped capital, so collusion does not help. Defender cost stays flat; attacker cost scales with keys, like timber that must be grown before it can be cut, freezing the attacker's margin to a tundra.
